test_exec_follows_env_cwd_after_cd: test ShellFileOperations._exec uses live env.cwd instead of init-time cached cwd after a cd command
test_patch_replace_targets_live_cwd: test ShellFileOperations.patch_replace targets the live working directory, not the init-time directory
test_explicit_cwd_arg_overrides_env: test ShellFileOperations._exec explicit cwd argument overrides both env.cwd and init-time self.cwd
test_fallback_to_init_cwd_without_env_cw: test ShellFileOperations falls back to init-time cwd when env lacks a cwd attribute
test_patch_replace_success_reflects_file: test ShellFileOperations.patch_replace success only returns true when file is actually written correctly
